description: Maps a character pair to the per-relation-level item sets awarded as their relationship level rises.

ID.simple: Relationship reward row id (usually <character A>_<character B>).
ID.technical: FName row key in StoryCharaRelateRewardDataTables (DTM +0x8A0). Used as the key in GameManager.UserInfo.Story.StudioNameInts_7C0 storing the last granted reward level; when that level is below the current pair level, MainMenuStory grants the missing item sets and stores the new level. Also used to create the reward-level-change records for the correlation diagram.

Id_Character_1.simple: First character of the rewarded pair.
Id_Character_1.technical: FName. Reward rows are selected by unordered character-pair match: the view widget accepts (1,2) or (2,1), and MainMenuStory uses both ids to look up the corresponding StoryCharaGraphPair rows and their directed start/current levels.

Id_Character_2.simple: Second character of the rewarded pair.
Id_Character_2.technical: FName; same unordered-pair selection as Id_Character_1. It is used for the reverse GraphPair lookup, whose start level and current level are combined with the first direction when deciding which reward tiers to grant.

Id_ItemSet.simple: ItemSet awarded at each relationship level.
Id_ItemSet.technical: TArray<FName> indexed as [Level - 1]; exported rows have five slots with None placeholders for early levels. MainMenuStory grants GameShop_AddItemSetOnce(Id_ItemSet[Level - 1], 6) for each newly crossed level between max(saved grant level, both GraphPair start levels) and min(both directed current levels). The reward view shows Id_ItemSet[ItemLevel - 1] for milestones between the pair's GraphPair StartRelateLevel and EndRelateLevel; the earned-reward list does the same for levels crossed in one increase.

notes: Reward level gating uses the minimum of the two directed current levels and the maximum of the saved grant level and both directed start levels; the saved level defaults to 1 in MainMenuStory and 0 in the reward view widget (Source/Abrams/Private/GamePhase_MainMenuStory.cpp:1112-1114, 1152-1157; Source/Abrams/Private/GameStoryCharaRelateRewardViewWidget.cpp:67-68).
Only pairs that are released (studio mission/pair-release flags) are considered before the grant scan; see GamePhase_MainMenuStory.cpp around 1090-1108.
44 exported rows; no numbered shards or locale variants. ItemSet contents themselves are in ItemSetDataTable and are not described here.

Evidence is from the reconstructed C++ in Source/ (row shape/counts from the exported table); status/ records byte matches for some owner TUs, but this file does not claim a retail byte comparison for every function or exhaustive Blueprint/runtime coverage.

usages.detail: Grants newly earned relationship reward item sets and records the last granted level per row id.
Shows the reward milestones for the selected pair, marking already-reached levels.
Displays the item set for levels crossed by a relationship level-up.
Explicit StoryFindRowOutOfLine instantiation for this row type (retail 0x166ec40).
